status: Validated utility; not yet integrated into default adaptive search
scope: Replay of full, retained and deleted predictions for saved validation supports. Small CPU/CUDA fixtures also compare gradients, weighted duplicate entries and isolated endpoints.
limitations: Applicable only under the documented local normalized-GCN assumptions; no arbitrary-model certificate is provided.
Node-count reduction is not a measured speedup; no controlled timing or peak-memory benchmark has been performed.

Float32 discrepancies can exceed the support search's gain threshold. Prediction agreement on saved supports does not establish identical proposal rankings, acceptance decisions or final search trajectories.
This computational optimization does not establish an independent benefit from spectral coarsening.
Original graph identities and sizes must remain authoritative for explanation metrics; compact graph sizes are not evidence sparsity denominators.
next_gate: Benchmark actual end-to-end cost, then validate an opt-in local search path with full-graph acceptance checks before considering default integration.
